research_rationale:
EO 14177 (January 23, 2025, 90 FR 8643, Federal Register FR Doc. 2025-02121) established the President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology (PCAST) in section 2, set its membership and co-chairs, gave it advisory functions including service as the President's Innovation and Technology Advisory Committee and the National Nanotechnology Advisory Panel (section 3), provided for administration by the Department of Energy and for clearances, subcommittees and unpaid service (section 4), set its term at two years unless extended (section 5), revoked EO 14007 (section 6) and added general provisions (section 7). I read the held Federal Register text layer of the whole order (verified whole-order span, three PDF pages) and confirm the dossier inventory of 25 scopes: the lead-in, sections 1 to 7 and their lettered and numbered subparts, with nothing omitted. Sections 2 to 5 and 7 are operative on 2026-10-14. The two-year term in section 5 would end on 2027-01-23 on its own terms, after the cutoff, and EO 14354 of September 29, 2025 (90 FR 48145, effective September 30, 2025) continues PCAST, listed in its section 1(u) with this order cited, until September 30, 2027. The U.S. Code (release point 119-121, current through 2026-10-09) prints the order in full as a note to 42 U.S.C. 6601 without any revocation or amendment annotation. Section 6, the revocation of EO 14007 (as amended by EO 14109), was a self-executing act performed on signing and is recorded as terminated on 2025-01-23. The EO 12968 reference is the order's own section 4(c) citation of that clearance order. The 'EO 14009, September 29, 2023' entry carries the date of EO 14109 (the order amending EO 14007 that section 6 itself names); the held text of EO 14009 (86 FR 7793, January 28, 2021) is Strengthening Medicaid and the Affordable Care Act and does not mention PCAST or this order. No held order revokes, supersedes or amends EO 14177.
